dev.notes: Default env. Tests what is already merged and deployed. The user's account is a full-rights admin here — role-restriction (negative) cases need a non-admin account.

local.notes: Tests an unmerged branch. FE: D:\Source\Ess\ess-fe (npm run dev). BE: D:\Source\Ess\ess-be (dotnet run --project src/Ess-App.API/Ess-App.API.csproj). Local BE calls whichever D365 environment appsettings points to (a shared D365), so writes are real D365 writes.
